sfx_fragrance_crystal.text: Luxury fragrance sonic logo: one crystal glass chime struck once, then a warm low felt-piano note underneath, soft shimmering reverb tail, elegant, no voice, no drums

sfx_beverage_snap.text: Energy drink sonic logo: sharp can-tab snap, quick rising synth swoosh, landing on one punchy sub-bass hit with a short fizz tail, no voice

sfx_tech_3note.text: Tech brand sonic logo: three-note ascending glass marimba motif, E then G sharp then B, clean and modern, last note sustains, no voice, no drums

music_tech_3note.text: Sonic logo, 3 seconds: three-note ascending glass marimba motif E, G sharp, B, then a soft warm synth pad chord in E major rings out. Clean, modern tech brand. Instrumental, no drums.
